data.name: Binding Touch
data.description: 1/day, you can use binding, but only at a range of touch. You need not expend any material components to use this ability, nor can assistance aid you in its casting. You can only have 1 creature affected by this ability at any one time. If you successfully use this ability on a second creature, the previously bound creature is immediately freed. This ability is the equivalent of a 7th-level spell.
